item.title: About
item.description: About Alan Blount I’m an AI/ML Engineer at Google in Boulder, Colorado, working on cutting-edge generative AI systems and agent memory architectures. I’ve been at Google for several years, focusing on building the infrastructure and tools that power the next generation of intelligent systems. Current Work at Google At Google, I’m deeply involved in: Generative AI Systems: Building and deploying large-scale AI applications Agent Memory Architectures: Designing memory systems that help AI agents remember and learn Memory Bank Platforms: Contributing to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Memory Bank deployment Production AI Infrastructure: Scaling AI systems to handle millions of users Open Source & Community I believe in giving back to the developer community through open source contributions:
